note: ChatCut Caption Cards are bounded by ASR words on their source speech item. cue_override success JSON is not proof; re-read cards and inspect the last timeline frame. Do not clone the same TTS asset as a muted hold to extend cards: that rematerializes a second card, cannot merge items, and overlapping same-asset spans fail. Do not use Motion Graphics as viewer captions. The configured final cut must keep one frozen-line caption through timeline_end_frame. If that hold cannot be proven, HOLD_CAPTION_TAIL_NOT_CLOSED (or HOLD_FINAL_VISUAL_NOT_VERIFIED when the tail picture itself is also unproven).
